title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 028
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute car and bus variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Front car outline with two round lights and a curved roof line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simple front view car with round lights.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the smoother grille or sharp headlight cars when the round lights matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the most basic front car with two round lights and a gentle roof curve.

items.depicts_observation: Front car outline with a wide curved grille line and no visible headlight dots
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a softer car front whose main cue is the wide curved grille.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the round light or sharp headlight cars when the blank front face matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot removes the round lights and centers the curved grille line as the main cue.

items.depicts_observation: Front car outline with two sharp angled headlight slashes at the sides
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the most aggressive car front with sharp side headlight marks.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the softer car fronts when the slanted headlight slashes are visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds sharp angled headlight slashes that are absent from the other car fronts.

items.depicts_observation: Front bus outline with a wide windshield band and two lower lights
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a head on bus with a broad windshield and front lights.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the side bus when the flat front transit face is the visible cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a front facing bus with a wide top windshield band and lower lights.

items.depicts_observation: Side bus outline with three window panels and two round wheels below
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a side view bus instead of a head on front panel.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the front bus when the side windows and wheels need to stay visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot rotates the bus into a side view with window panels and wheels.
